name: Transparency International
summary: A global anti-corruption movement founded in 1993, with more than 100 national chapters and an international Secretariat in Berlin (Transparency International e.V.), which also runs offices in Brussels and Washington. The Secretariat publishes the Corruption Perceptions Index, campaigns for global and EU anti-corruption rules (beneficial-ownership transparency, political finance, ending golden passports), brings legal cases, and funds and supports the chapters, whose Advocacy and Legal Advice Centres help people who meet corruption. It spent EUR 28.0 million in 2025, about half of it as grants to chapters and partners.
